quota.imageLabPlan: No quota used when previewing prompts, scoring existing images, or building analytics recommendations.
quota.freshImages: Uses image quota only when a build action generates new images through OpenAI or Google AI.
quota.googleAi: Used after OpenAI is unavailable; capped locally at 100 images/day and 2 images/minute by default.
quota.pexels: Used as a stock fallback after generated and banked art when PEXELS_API_KEY is configured.
quota.pixabay: Reserved as the last external fallback after OpenAI, Google AI, banked images, Pexels, and local fallback.
quota.bankedImages: Uses no external quota; respects cooldown and bank counts.
quota.analytics: Uses no OpenAI/image quota when reading saved metrics or logged-in page metrics through Playwright.

local_stable_diffusion.use: primary local SDXL/diffusers image pipeline before external quota providers

pexels.use: stock fallback images and background videos

pixabay.use: last external stock image fallback before emergency local graphics
